steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Access main control
steps.body: Remove console. Verify ALL connectors fully seated at main control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove console. Verify ALL connectors fully seated at main control.

steps.title: Restore power for line check
steps.body: Plug in or reconnect power for live measurements only.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Plug in or reconnect power for live measurements only.

steps.title: Line voltage J5-1 to J5-2
steps.body: AC voltmeter: black probe J5-2 (Neutral), red probe J5-1 (L1). Expect 120 VAC.

branches.label: No line voltage
branches.oemOutcome: Check outlet, breaker, and AC power cord continuity.

steps.sourceExcerpt: AC voltmeter: black probe J5-2 (Neutral), red probe J5-1 (L1). Expect 120 VAC.

steps.title: Diagnostic LED state
steps.body: Is the Diagnostic LED ON or OFF? (ON = +5 VDC present, micro operating.)
steps.sourceExcerpt: Is the Diagnostic LED ON or OFF? (ON = +5 VDC present, micro operating.)

steps.title: +12 VDC at J12
steps.body: DC volts: black J12-4 (Circuit Gnd), red J12-1 (+12 VDC). Do not short pins inside header.
steps.sourceExcerpt: DC volts: black J12-4 (Circuit Gnd), red J12-1 (+12 VDC). Do not short pins inside header.

steps.title: Isolate shifter load on J12
steps.body: Disconnect power. Remove connector J12 from main control. Restore power and repeat Diagnostic LED and +12 VDC checks at J12 header.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power. Remove connector J12 from main control. Restore power and repeat Diagnostic LED and +12 VDC checks at J12 header.

steps.title: DC supplies return with J12 removed?
steps.body: With J12 disconnected, does Diagnostic LED turn ON and +12 VDC return?

branches.label: DC returns — shifter/harness short
branches.oemOutcome: Check harness between main control and shifter; replace shifter assembly if harness good.

steps.sourceExcerpt: With J12 disconnected, does Diagnostic LED turn ON and +12 VDC return?

branches.oemOutcome: Check outlet, breaker, and AC power cord continuity.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 3.8 cu ft Top Load Washer with Removable Agitator (WTW4950)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Manual Test valve pre-check
steps.body: In Manual Test Mode, run Cold and Hot Valve tests. Note any valve that fails to energize.
steps.sourceExcerpt: In Manual Test Mode, run Cold and Hot Valve tests. Note any valve that fails to energize.

steps.title: Disconnect J9 at main control
steps.body: Unplug washer. Remove console. Disconnect J9 from main control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug washer. Remove console. Disconnect J9 from main control.

steps.title: Valve coil resistance at J9
steps.body: Measure each coil across J9-4 (L1 common) and valve pin: Hot J9-1, Cold J9-5. Expect 890 Ω to 1.3 kΩ.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure each coil across J9-4 (L1 common) and valve pin: Hot J9-1, Cold J9-5. Expect 890 Ω to 1.3 kΩ.

steps.title: Reconnect J9 and restore power
steps.body: Reconnect J9. Reassemble panels. Restore power for Manual Test Mode valve exercise.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect J9. Reassemble panels. Restore power for Manual Test Mode valve exercise.

steps.title: Continue to Manual Test Mode
steps.body: You should now be in Service Diagnostic mode. Turn cycle selector to Spin + Done LEDs, then press START for Manual Test Mode load commands.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Diagnostic mode must be active before Manual Test Mode (Spin + Done, START).

steps.title: Valves energize in Manual Test Mode
steps.body: Toggle Cold/Hot valve tests in Manual Test Mode. Does each valve in question turn on?

branches.label: Ohms OK but valve does not run
branches.oemOutcome: Coils in range but no run — replace main control and calibrate.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Toggle Cold/Hot valve tests in Manual Test Mode. Does each valve in question turn on?

branches.label: Ohms OK but valve does not run
branches.oemOutcome: Coils in range but no run — replace main control and calibrate.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 3.8 cu ft Top Load Washer with Removable Agitator (WTW4950)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Enter Service Diagnostic and clear codes
steps.body: Activate Service Diagnostic mode. Retrieve and clear F7-E1, F7-E5, and motor speed codes if present.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Activate Service Diagnostic mode. Retrieve and clear F7-E1, F7-E5, and motor speed codes if present.

steps.title: Heavy Agitate runs 15–20 sec
steps.body: Enter Manual Test Mode. Run Heavy Agitate. Does motor run after 15–20 seconds?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Enter Manual Test Mode. Run Heavy Agitate. Does motor run after 15–20 seconds?

steps.title: Spin test completes
steps.body: In Manual Test Mode, command spin. If motor hums briefly then stops (lid lock blinking), check Fault Code Display for shifter/basket speed errors.
steps.sourceExcerpt: In Manual Test Mode, command spin. If motor hums briefly then stops (lid lock blinking), check Fault Code Display for shifter/basket speed errors.

steps.title: Continue to shifter or motor test
steps.body: Shifter-related (F7E5, basket speed) → TEST #3a Shifter. Motor circuit (F7E6, F7E7) → TEST #3b Motor.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Shifter-related (F7E5, basket speed) → TEST #3a Shifter. Motor circuit (F7E6, F7E7) → TEST #3b Motor.

steps.body: Lid closed and locked. Run Spin and Agitate tests. Did shifter engage for both?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Lid closed and locked. Run Spin and Agitate tests. Did shifter engage for both?

steps.title: Basket turns freely
steps.body: Power off. Basket should turn freely. If not, resolve mechanical friction or lockup.

branches.label: Does not turn freely
branches.oemOutcome: Determine and correct mechanical friction or lockup.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Basket should turn freely. If not, resolve mechanical friction or lockup.

steps.title: J12 and J2 fully seated
steps.body: Verify J12 and J2 inserted fully at main control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify J12 and J2 inserted fully at main control.

steps.title: Reseat J12/J2 and retest
steps.body: Reconnect connectors and repeat Manual Test Spin/Agitate.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect connectors and repeat Manual Test Spin/Agitate.

steps.title: Shifter motor resistance J2-1 to J2-2
steps.body: Remove J2. Expect 2 kΩ to 3.5 kΩ across shifter motor. Verify splutch cam moves freely before electrical checks.

testPoint.label: Shifter motor resistance J2-1 to J2-2

measurements.title: Shifter motor resistance J2-1 to J2-2

steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove J2. Expect 2 kΩ to 3.5 kΩ across shifter motor. Verify splutch cam moves freely before electrical checks.

steps.title: 120 VAC at shifter when commanded
steps.body: Restore power. AC volts J2-2 (L1) to J2-1 (N). Toggle Spin/Agitate in Manual Test Mode (4–15 sec state change). Expect 120 VAC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Restore power. AC volts J2-2 (L1) to J2-1 (N). Toggle Spin/Agitate in Manual Test Mode (4–15 sec state change). Expect 120 VAC.

steps.title: Shifter switch voltage J12-3
steps.body: DC volts: black J12-4 (Gnd), red J12-3. Toggle Spin/Agitate — SPIN = +5 VDC, AGITATE = 0 VDC.
steps.sourceExcerpt: DC volts: black J12-4 (Gnd), red J12-3. Toggle Spin/Agitate — SPIN = +5 VDC, AGITATE = 0 VDC.

steps.title: +12 VDC and tachometer verification
steps.body: DC volts J12-4 to J12-1 expect +12 VDC. Enter Tachometer Verification Mode; slowly turn basket — status LEDs should illuminate sequentially.
steps.sourceExcerpt: DC volts J12-4 to J12-1 expect +12 VDC. Enter Tachometer Verification Mode; slowly turn basket — status LEDs should illuminate sequentially.

steps.title: Shifter harness continuity
steps.body: Power off. Tilt washer. Continuity shifter pins to J12/J2 per OEM chart (pins 1–6 to J12-2, J12-1, J2-2, J12-3, J12-4, J2-1)?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Tilt washer. Continuity shifter pins to J12/J2 per OEM chart (pins 1–6 to J12-2, J12-1, J2-2, J12-3, J12-4, J2-1)?

testPoint.label: Shifter motor resistance J2-1 to J2-2

measurements.title: Shifter motor resistance J2-1 to J2-2

branches.oemOutcome: Determine and correct mechanical friction or lockup.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Resistance checks must be made with washer unplugged or power disconnected.

steps.title: Agitate and spin in Manual Test Mode

steps.sourceExcerpt: Run Gentle or Heavy Agitation and Low/High Spin. Basket should spin clockwise on spin tests.

steps.title: Basket turns freely
steps.body: Power off. Basket should turn freely.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Basket should turn freely.

steps.title: J12 and J2 fully seated
steps.body: Verify J12 and J2 fully inserted at main control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Verify J12 and J2 fully inserted at main control.

steps.title: Reseat connectors and retest
steps.body: Reconnect J12/J2 and repeat Manual Test agitate/spin.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Reconnect J12/J2 and repeat Manual Test agitate/spin.

steps.title: Live motor voltage check
steps.body: Restore power. Run Gentle Agitation in Manual Test Mode.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Restore power. Run Gentle Agitation in Manual Test Mode.

steps.title: 120 VAC cycling on CW winding
steps.body: AC volts J2-4 (L1) to J2-6 (CW). Expect 120 VAC cycling ON during CW rotation.
steps.sourceExcerpt: AC volts J2-4 (L1) to J2-6 (CW). Expect 120 VAC cycling ON during CW rotation.

steps.title: 120 VAC cycling on CCW winding
steps.body: AC volts J2-4 (L1) to J2-5 (CCW). Expect 120 VAC cycling ON during CCW rotation.
steps.sourceExcerpt: AC volts J2-4 (L1) to J2-5 (CCW). Expect 120 VAC cycling ON during CCW rotation.

steps.title: Disconnect power for ohms
steps.body: Unplug washer. Remove J2 from main control.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Unplug washer. Remove J2 from main control.

steps.title: Motor winding resistance at J2
steps.body: CW J2-4↔6 and CCW J2-4↔5. 1/4 HP: 5–9.5 Ω each; 1/3 HP (4 rotary switches): 3.5–6 Ω each.
steps.sourceExcerpt: CW J2-4↔6 and CCW J2-4↔5. 1/4 HP: 5–9.5 Ω each; 1/3 HP (4 rotary switches): 3.5–6 Ω each.

steps.title: Motor harness continuity
steps.body: Tilt washer. Continuity motor connector to J2 and run capacitor per OEM chart?
steps.sourceExcerpt: Tilt washer. Continuity motor connector to J2 and run capacitor per OEM chart?

steps.title: Motor resistance at drive connector
steps.body: At motor: CW pins 4↔2 and CCW pins 3↔2. Expect same Ω range as J2 measurement.
steps.sourceExcerpt: At motor: CW pins 4↔2 and CCW pins 3↔2. Expect same Ω range as J2 measurement.

steps.title: Run capacitor charge/discharge test
steps.body: Discharge capacitor with 20 kΩ resistor. Measure terminals — steady increase = good; short/open = replace capacitor.

branches.label: Capacitor shorted or open
branches.oemOutcome: Replace run capacitor, calibrate, and retest.
